newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Camesa plans single share series.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Camesa plans single share series.

text.p: Grupo Industrial Camesa, maker of steel cable and fluorspar miner, plans to combine its A and B series shares into a single share series, Mexican brokerage Finamex reported Thursday.
"Creating a single series, with 306,503,960 shares outstanding, will improve liquidity and facilitate the participation of foreign investors," Finamex said.
The company now has 156,317,000 A shares and 150,186,960 free-subscription B shares, Finamex said.
It gave no details of when the share combination would take place. Camesa officials were not immediately available to comment.
